To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the total loss of vertical prestressing is mainly caused by the anchorage slip and the long-term factors, while the friction loss and the elastic compression loss of the concrete members are relatively small.

the total loss of vertical prestresses of the webs of concrete box girders is greater than that calculated according to the formulas of Code JTGD62, which are mainly composed by that due anchorage slip and the long-term factors, the loss due to anchor slip is the biggest part of the total loss, which is evidently affected by fixing error and tightening torque of anchors.
the loss of vertical pre-stressing is mainly caused by the slip of anchorages and long-term factors.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the vertical prestress loss of the webs of prestressed concrete box beams and its main influencing factors.
the loss of vertical pre-stress in the webs of concrete box girders and the effect of fixing error of anchors on the prestress loss.
the loss of vertical pre-stressing force in the webs of concrete box girders.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the total loss of vertical prestressing force is composed of the loss due to slip of anchorage and the long-term loss, and the loss caused by the fixing error and the tightening level can be neglected.

the loss due to long-term factors and the loss due anchorage slip should be taken into consideration in design, and the loss of vertical pre-stress due to anchorage should be calculated according to the actual conditions of the construction.

the loss of vertical pre-stress is mainly composed by the loss due to slip of anchorage and the long-term loss, and the former takes the biggest part, so the loss due to fixing error of the anchor should be paid more attention to.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the loss due to fixing error of the anchor board is the main reason for the loss of vertical pre-stress in the web of concrete box girders.
the loss of vertical pre-tension in webs of prestressed box girders is mainly composed by loss due to anchoring slip and long-term loss.
the loss of vertical pre-stress in the webs of prestressed concrete box girder is very complex and cannot be ignored.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is important to improve the accuracy of fixing the anchorage boards, to reduce the loss of vertical pre-stress, to ensure the safety of the box girders and to reduce the construction cost.
the loss of prestress due to fixing error of the anchorage board is a new kind of loss of prestress, which should be taken into account in the design.
the loss due to slip of the anchorage is the main loss of vertical pre-stress.
